column1: # English explicit terms — page-text scoring tier.
# Weight is a confidence, not a severity. It answers one question: "if this word
# appears on a page, how sure am I that the page is adult content?"
#   6.0  strong      — a medical or news page could use it, but rarely
#   4.0  moderate    — needs company to mean anything
# The scorer caps each term at 3 occurrences and divides by document length, so
# a long clinical article that uses a 6.0 term twice does not cross the
# threshold. That is what keeps Wikipedia and medical sites reachable — do NOT
# compensate for a missed page by inflating a weight here; add a more specific
# Terms are normalised at compile time, so case and accents do not matter.
